note: The shots `bun run batch` takes in the built player, in this order (tools/game/shots.schema.ts says what each key does). A round that wants a new picture adds a row here. Shots with the same start go on in one run while their ticks do not go back; a shot at an earlier tick restarts the run. Views are keys of the host's figures (op/scout, waitress, guard, car/getaway, camera/entrance, patrol). Captures are 1920x1080 (the size the HUD budget is defined at) unless a row gives size; world-only shots and clip frames are JPEG, HUD shots PNG. First written 2026-10-21, before the first run in the player: adjust a row that frames badly.
